title: The tally app
summary: The tally panel's view and flow in a project, Flow and the View Builder to open them, and Export app.
task: Open the tally panel in the View Builder and export it as an app that runs without Workshop.
choose: you want to see a view and a flow become an app folder that zengine-app runs on its own.
prepares: a project holding tally.view and tally.flow, as the View Builder and Flow save them
the Demo controls on the desk

first_task.do: Open the View Builder, type tally.view in its path box, press Open, then Export app.
first_task.expect: The View Builder says Exported, and apps/tally/ in the project holds the app with run.cmd and run.sh.

variations: Run app from the View Builder, then quit Workshop: the app's window still counts
limits: Reset puts the desk back; it does not remove an exported app from the project

reset.keeps: tally.view, tally.flow and any exported app

export.about: Flow and the View Builder opened, tally.view opened in the View Builder, and Export app
